defects.note: String is declared on *Credentials and c.creds is a value, so slog never sees a Stringer: the handler prints the struct's fields and the secret lands in the log at Debug. Redaction that depends on the receiver kind is not redaction; log ShopID

one bytes.Reader serves every attempt; the first Do reads it to EOF, so the request the second attempt builds has Len() 0 and goes out with an empty body. Every retry the loop exists for turns into a 400 the partner is not at fault for. bytes.NewReader(body) inside the loop

try runs once per attempt and mints a fresh key each time, so the deduplication Submit's doc relies on never applies to a retry: a timeout after the partner accepted the first attempt creates a second shipment. One key per Submit, set before the loop
the header is in seconds and the conversion makes nanoseconds, so a Retry-After of 30 asks for a 30 ns pause; the max with backoff hides it. time.Duration(secs) * time.Second
Label fetches a URL derived from the same receipt Status guards with partnerURL, and does not call it: a tampered receipt reaches any https host with the bearer token attached

defects.match: if ferr := bw.Flush(); ferr != nil && err == nil {
defects.note: Label's results are unnamed, so the deferred assignment lands in a local after the return value was already taken; a short write on Flush is reported as success and the doc's 'complete when Label returns nil' is false. Name the result: (err error)

HasSuffix without a leading dot accepts evilpartner.example for partner.example, so the allowlist a tampered receipt is checked against is any host whose name ends in the partner's. Equal to c.domain, or HasSuffix of "."+c.domain
one cancel per tick is deferred until Wait returns, so a shipment polled every few seconds for a day holds thousands of timers and contexts; cancel at the end of the iteration

EncodeReceipt writes RawURLEncoding, without padding, and DecodeReceipt reads URLEncoding, which requires it: every receipt whose payload length is not a multiple of three fails to decode, and Status and Label are unusable for two thirds of shipments. The tests pass because their payloads happen to be multiples of three

int(elapsed.Seconds()) is 0 for anything under a second and last is then moved to now, so a bucket asked more often than once a second never refills: after the burst every call is throttled for good. Keep the fractional remainder, or refill from the unmoved last

nothing marks the probe as taken, so once the cooldown has passed every caller is a probe until one of them calls Record; a recovering partner receives the whole backlog at once. Move openedAt to now when the probe is granted

the test accepts any error and in fact passes for the wrong reason: the receipt's 34-byte payload does not decode under URLEncoding, so the host check is never reached. Assert the error the test is about

defects.note: New accepts a base with no scheme or host; url.Parse of partner.example/api yields an empty Hostname, and HasSuffix(anything, "") is true, so the receipt guard passes every host. Refuse a base without https and a host

a refusal by the shop's own limiter consumes one of the three attempts meant for partner failures; three throttled loops fail the submission without a single request going out. Wait for a token, or keep the budget for the partner
